blocks.text: For SM Supermalls, building a more sustainable and resource-resilient future means working with partners and industry innovators to turn shared environmental goals into meaningful action. Together with ozone technology expert PureO3 Philippines (PureO3), the newly launched Rainwater Treatment Facilisty (RTF) system at SM City Masinag provides this proactive approach as communities face increasing pressure from prolonged dry spells. “Our work with SM Supermalls contributes to the larger sustainable movement. We see these projects as an opportunity to advance water sustainability while improving resource and operational efficiency,” said Merlin Andrew Te, General Manager for PureO3.
